gloss: to get angry; to take offense

definitions.gloss: to get angry at; to take offense; to lose one's temper
definitions.explanation: The transitive counterpart of {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ: to become angry at something, presented as the person's own reaction; literally 'to raise the belly.' The cause is marked with に: {冗談|じょうだん}に{腹|はら}を{立|た}てる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹|はら}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: He got angry at my joke.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{腹|はら}を{立|た}てるな⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't get worked up over something so small.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹|はら}を{立|た}てた⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: A customer who had taken offense at the clerk's attitude began complaining loudly.

notes:
Literally 'to set up one's belly.' Compared with ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧, where the anger rises by itself, {腹|はら}を{立|た}てる presents the anger as the person's own reaction, so it is the form used to tell someone not to get angry.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腹|はら}を{立|た}てる: to get angry at ~
- {腹|はら}を{立|た}てるな: don't get angry
- {腹|はら}を{立|た}てて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be angry (state)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧: to get angry — the intransitive pair; the feeling arises
- ⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧: to get angry; to scold — the plain verb
- ⟦{頭|あたま}に{来|く}る→頭に来る：30587_atamanikuru⟧: to lose one's temper — more sudden and colloquial
